body:
Tea: 3 tsp. of dried damiana boiled in 500mL of water for 10 minutes. A tablespoon of honey mixed in.
T = 21:25: 100mL Taste is quite nice, a little earthy but balanced thanks to the honey. I chugged the cup down and now have that feeling in my stomach that you get after a big bowl of hot soup.
T+5: Calming effects have set in. When I sit down, it feels as though every organ and limb is sinking down into themselves in the most comfortable way, the getting swallowed by a bed kind of way.
T+10: Another 100mL.  After drinking another cup, I feel completely freed of any anxiety of tension (both mental and physical), but not so much as that there is an entire change of senses (such as with THC), but just a natural, relaxed, neutral feeling.
T+15: Time is flying by, its extremely easy to just zone out watching something or thinking about something.
T+20: Another 100mL.
T+30: My eyes kind of sting and I feel sleepy.
T+32: Finish the last 200mL.
T+45: Feeling super peaceful and pleasantly tired.
Take aways:
Great for relief of muscle aches and back pain etc.
Very calming
. Definitely not a replacement for weed, damiana gives a much more lucid high, but similar in time distortion and the release of stress and tension.
